payload.reason: The evidence provides specific competitive results achieved by the Jasper model on various datasets, including LibriSpeech, Wall Street Journal, and Fisher+Switchboard.

claims.text: The Jasper model achieved a state-of-the-art WER of 2.95% on LibriSpeech test-clean using a beam-search decoder with an external language model.
The model also reported a WER of 3.86% on LibriSpeech test-clean using a greedy decoder without a language model.
Competitive results were obtained on the Wall Street Journal and Fisher+Switchboard datasets.
